about: A self-hosted web app that keeps your two-factor accounts and shows their login codes.

prs.title: Bitwarden vault imports work when some items have no code
prs.broken: Importing a Bitwarden export failed with an error unless every item was a login with a two-factor code, which almost no real vault is. Notes, cards and plain logins broke it.
prs.changed: Items without a code are now skipped, and a code saved as a bare key is read as the secret.
prs.matters: People moving from Bitwarden can import their whole vault in one go.
